title: Things tip: moving items to headings
summary: How to specify a heading within a project when moving a to-do in Things.
content:
I'll Bold and Capitalise Things features for clarity.

Quick tip for the Things users. Let's say you have a Project named 21 Products and in there a Heading named 21.35 JDHQ. Which I do. (The names aren't important; substitute your own.)

I use Things' lovely Move… feature to flick items from my Inbox to these Headings. I prefer to use the number, because I know it and it's faster. My ideal workflow is:

  1. When processing the item, press Shift-Cmd-M for Move.
  2. Type 21.35, which matches a Heading inside a Project.
  3. Press return.

The problem is I've created work packages whose number contains 21.25. Things will prefer matching a number in a Project and if it finds one, it won't offer you the number even if it matches a Heading.

Stack your searches

The solution is deceptively simple: just use a more specific search.

If you use 21 21.35 it seems to understand that I want to search in Project 21 for Heading 21.35. And that's exactly what I want.
